summary: Wrote a three-phase sequential plan for the Reflection clause of app:presheaf-dictionary as one new module FormalSystem/Semantics/Presheaf/Reflection.lean: Phase 1 the reflection automorphism Tr.ref and its five laws, Phase 2 the section reflection, naturality, involution and Beh.reflectEquiv, Phase 3 aggregator/README/record wiring plus the full gate. Every statement is carried in the plan's Lean Challenge Statements section, which type-checks standalone.
